class.name: HeightmapTerrainMesh
class.brief_description: Editable heightfield mesh with sculpting and four vertex-color layer masks.
class.description: [HeightmapTerrainMesh] generates an X/Z triangle grid with stored heights, computed normals and vertex-color material masks. Add it as a mesh in [MeshInstance3D]. Call brush methods using local X/Z coordinates. [method raise_brush], [method flatten_brush] and [method smooth_brush] change heights; [method paint_layer] blends four material weights in the [code]COLOR.rgba[/code] channels. This is a CPU heightfield and brush API, not yet a complete terrain editor. It has no viewport brush UI, clipmap LOD, runtime collision, hydraulic erosion or vegetation spawning. Mesh geometry is rebuilt after edits. Changing [member grid_size] resets the saved height and layer arrays.

method.name: flatten_brush
method.description: Blends heights toward the specified height using strength from 0 to 1.

method.name: get_local_height
method.description: Interpolates height in local X/Z coordinates, clamped at mesh edges.

method.name: paint_layer
method.description: Paints one vertex-color layer: 0 is red, 1 is green, 2 is blue and 3 is alpha.

method.name: raise_brush
method.description: Raises or lowers heights using linear radial falloff.

method.name: smooth_brush
method.description: Smooths heights with neighbors, reading from the original array in each pass.

members.member: Vertex dimensions, each from 2 to 512. Resizing resets heights and layer masks.
Row-major height samples persisted with the mesh; hidden from the Inspector for performance.
Normalized RGBA material weights for each vertex, defaulting to layer zero.
Horizontal extent in local X/Z units.
